title: Anganwadi Worker, Anganwadi Helper
summary: UP Anganwadi Pilibhit has announced recruitment for 283 vacancies for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper positions. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official portal before the deadline of December 3, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum educational qualification requires 10th or 12th standard completion as per norms.
Candidates must apply online through the official designated website before the closing date.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official application portal at http://upanganwadibharti.in
Review the detailed notification and verify eligibility requirements.
Complete the online application form and submit it on or before 2026-12-03.
